exposure: Time periods: before and after the COVID-19 pandemic
cohort: Pregnant women and newborns in Kiambu County, Kenya
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic was associated with a decrease in antenatal care visits, skilled deliveries, and family planning uptake, but an increase in postnatal care attendance and caesarean section rates in Kiambu County, Kenya.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates increased by 12.7% during the COVID-19 pandemic.
